title: City Council Meeting
motion: MOVED TO TABLE THE RE-APPOINTMENT OF KARI HARBATH AND SHARDAE JONES, WITH THEIR TERMS TO EXPIRE MARCH 7, 2025; AND THE APPOINTMENT OF JULIANA WOODBURY AND C. FERNANDO MORALES, WITH THEIR TERMS TO EXPIRE MARCH 7, 2025 TO THE DIVERSITY COMMISSION. MOTION WAS SECONDED BY COUNCIL MEMBER LOPEZ,

title: City Council Meeting
motion: ON A MOTION BY COUNCIL MEMBER WHITE AND SECONDED BY COUNCIL MEMBER HYER, ORDINANCE WAS PASSED AND ADOPTED AS OGDEN CITY ORDINANCE 2023-15 AND ORDERED POSTED AS REQUIRED BY LAW [ENTITLED: "An ordinance of Ogden City, Utah, amending the Ogden Municipal Code by amending Subsection 15-4-5.J; by amending Section 15-13-5; by amending Subsection 14-14-4.D to set a maximum height of four stories or 50-feet in the R-3 zone and to modify setback standards for tall buildings adjacent to residential or open space zones; and providing that this ordinance shall become effective immediately upon posting after final passage."]
